what: The seal's stamp as chapter 13 draws it: Parc fermé's gate at 09:15:17 CT on Nov 25, its clock, and the sealing ring lit gold as the Nov 26 root lands on BNB Chain, before the 10:00 CT gate.

code.note: packages/world as on main (base), plus the rig named here (src/stations/_objects): the stations' own builders and frames from the frame data, with the rig's camera, or the chapter's own with its lens narrowed onto the object where the frame is a crop

render.command: packages/world: sh scripts/serve.sh <port>, then node scripts/render.mjs --port <port> --frames _objects.seal-stamp --out <dir> --w 1280 --h 720 --scale 2 --plates 0 --raw --repeat 2
render.gpu: ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M1 Max

png_1280.size: 1280 x 720, render.mjs's Lanczos from the master

png_640.size: 640 x 360, ffmpeg's Lanczos from the master

rerender_when: Parc fermé (stations/grid/r02.ts), the story's beat (story/beats.ts sealed), the rig, or the frame data changes
